text.p: Here are the main radio headlines from Lithuania's M-1 Plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ignalina nuclear power plant has fired an engineer for drinking on the job, frequently missing work, and aggressive behaviour. Staff said they would only follow his orders if they were sure he was sober.
- Experts say hexogen was the material used in an explosive device which blew up outside of an interior ministry rest home in the seaside resort of Palanga at the weekend.
- Lithuanian border guards say that they detected no illegal crossing by a Russian TV crew that was arrested in Belarus for allegedly filming a closed area of the Lithuania-Belarus border.
